```{r}
#| label: wall-setup
#| include: false
#|

# Install/load packages if needed
if (!requireNamespace("showtext", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("showtext")
}
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("ggplot2")
}

if (!requireNamespace("systemfonts", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("systemfonts")
}

library(showtext)
library(ggplot2)
library(systemfonts)

## Clean the slate
systemfonts::clear_local_fonts()
systemfonts::clear_registry()


# Add three Google Fonts
# Arguments: font family name, Google Font name
font_add_google("Roboto Condensed", "Roboto Condensed")
font_add_google("Lato", "Lato")
font_add_google("Alegreya", "Alegreya")
font_add_google("Montserrat", "Montserrat")

# Tell R to use showtext for all subsequent plots
showtext_auto()

# Optional: set DPI for raster devices (adjust if you need high-res PNGs)
showtext_opts(dpi = 300)

# Set a site-wide ggplot theme using the loaded fonts
ggplot2::theme_set(
  ggplot2::theme_bw(
    base_size = 14,
    base_family = "Roboto Condensed"
  )
)

## Set the ggplot theme
theme_madhatter <- function(){ 

    theme_bw(base_size = 10) + # Base Theme, Black-White
    
    theme_sub_axis(title = element_text(family = "Roboto Condensed", 
                                       size = 8),
                   text = element_text(family = "Roboto Condensed", 
                                       size = 6)) + 
    
    theme_sub_legend(text = element_text(family = "Roboto Condensed", 
                                         size = 6),
                     title = element_text(family = "Alegreya", 
                                          size = 8)) + 
    
    theme_sub_plot(title = element_text(family = "Alegreya", 
                                        size = 14, face = "bold"),
                   title.position = "plot",
                   subtitle = element_text(family = "Montserrat", 
                                           size = 10),
                   caption = element_text(family = "Alegreya", 
                                          size = 6),
                   caption.position = "plot")
    
}

## Set the theme for all plots
ggplot2::theme_set(theme_madhatter())

## Update the fonts for geoms as well!
## Use available fonts in ggplot label and text within the ggplot geoms 
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(geom = "text", new = list(
  family = "Roboto Condensed",
  face = "plain",
  size = 8/ggplot2::.pt, # Converting 8 points to "mm" default
  color = "#2b2b2b"
)
)
ggplot2::update_geom_defaults(geom = "label", new = list(
  family = "Roboto Condensed",
  face = "plain",
  size = 8/ggplot2::.pt, # Converting 8 points to "mm" default
  color = "#2b2b2b"
)
)


```
